name: Lonebrow's Journal
summary: At the Great Lift in Thousand Needles, Henrig Lonebrow lies dead with Lonebrow's Journal in his hand. Its pages trace his last journey and ask you to carry the book west to a night elf druid at the Feralas border.

sections.title: A Fallen Explorer
sections.body: Henrig Lonebrow lies near the Great Lift, the huge machine that carries travelers from the Barrens to the floor of Thousand Needles. His journal remains in his hand, filled with notes from his travels through the canyon. Centaur and tauren hold this harsh country. His death shows the peril of traveling here alone.

sections.title: A Dying Request
sections.body: Henrig's journal records the route he meant to take and his final wish. He hoped his records would reach friendly hands instead of decaying in the canyon. Follow the road west across Thousand Needles and out of its dry gullies toward Thalanaar. The night elf outpost guards the Feralas border, where its druid, Falfindel Waywarder, awaits news from you.

sections.title: Uncovering the Kraul
sections.body: Falfindel Waywarder finds signs of a wider menace in Southern Kalimdor among Lonebrow's notes. Henrig's observations point north to the bramble-choked warrens of Razorfen Kraul. A dangerous crone leads the quilboar who dwell there.

faq.q: Where do I find Henrig Lonebrow's body?
faq.answer: Henrig Lonebrow's body lies at the foot of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles. From the bottom of the western elevator ramp, go about twenty-five feet toward a low rock ledge. His body rests there with the journal in hand.

faq.q: Who do I deliver the journal to?
faq.answer: Take the journal to Falfindel Waywarder, a night elf druid stationed at Thalanaar. The outpost lies along the main road west, on the border between Thousand Needles and Feralas.

Henrig Lonebrow was a dwarven traveler crossing central Kalimdor. He died near the base of the Great Lift, leaving a weathered journal with observations of the surrounding lands and dangerous quilboar movements.

faq.q: What does this quest lead to?
faq.answer: Deliver the journal to Falfindel Waywarder, and the path opens to The Crone of the Kraul. It sends Alliance adventurers into Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Can Horde players pick up the journal?
faq.answer: No. Only Alliance players can take the journal and follow the chain it begins. The chain leads to the Alliance border post at Thalanaar.

faq.q: Why was Lonebrow heading toward Thalanaar?
faq.answer: Lonebrow was heading to Thalanaar, the nearest Alliance outpost in the region and a sanctuary between Thousand Needles and the wilds of Feralas. He meant to share his observations of the region with the night elves stationed there.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Henrig Lonebrow's death reminds you of the dangers dwarven explorers face far from Ironforge, in Kalimdor's wild corners.
As an Alliance member, you know there are few outposts between Theramore and Thalanaar. Recover Lonebrow's journal to carry vital intelligence to Alliance allies before the canyon claims it.
As a druid, you can see why Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar watches for unnatural shifts in the local ecosystem. Lonebrow's notes about the quilboar in Razorfen matter to the Cenarion Circle.
